title: plugin-approvals: the Approval Requests column "Record ID" shows the target record's name, so call the field "Record" (#27356 row 7)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibz8HEj53Wx2uphTo2o

Filing gate: ① a named defect seen in a customer walk-through (a label that says the wrong thing). Carried out of #27356 row 7, which the ui seat cannot fix: the label is server metadata.

## Business reason

**Who:** an administrator reading Setup › Approval Requests (HotCRM walk-through, [hotcrm#2320 Setup S9](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420)). **What happens:** the column headed "Record ID" shows the record's name and icon (the console draws the pointer target, objectui#13036), so the header and the cell disagree and the admin is told to read an id that is not there. **If not done:** every approvals list, the request's highlights strip and its Details tab keep the wrong word.

## Mechanism

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` L269–270: `record_id: Field.text({ label: 'Record ID', … })`, the id half of the request's pointer pair (ADR-0052 §5).
- L121–126: the list views carry `record_id` alone and the console draws the target record (its object's icon and name) in that cell.
- The same column heads all four list views (L133, L142, L156, L166) and `highlightFields` (L82).

## Fix

Relabel the field "Record" (the walk-through's word), and carry the new label through wherever this object's field labels are translated or pinned (language packs, label tests). The field name `record_id`, its queries and its lock pair stay unchanged.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The Approval Requests list header, the request's highlights and Details read "Record" (and its translation where a pack carries the field).
- [ ] No query, seed or pointer-pair test changes behaviour; `record_id` is still the stored name.

## Reader and dedupe

- **Who acts:** `domain:server` (plugin-approvals).
- **Dedupe:** issue search "approval request Record ID column label shows record name": 26 hits, none about this label. #24501 (the Object column) and #26181 (notifications name the record by id) are related and closed.

Refs #27356 · Refs #24501
